#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is that the password reset email contains a link with the base URL pointing to "http://localhost:3000" instead of the correct production or staging URL. This happens because the constant BASE_URL is set using the environment variable PUBLIC_URL, but it falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not defined. This causes all password reset emails to include links to localhost, which do not work for the users. The fix likely involves ensuring the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is correctly set in the deployment environment or modifying the code to use a more appropriate base URL in production.
